description: Search the available FavCRM tool catalog for relevant operations. Use this when the curated direct tool list does not contain the operation you need.

includeInputSchema.description: Include full JSON input schemas for returned tools. Defaults to false to keep context small.

query.description: Plain-language tool search, e.g. "delete a segment" or "set custom field values"

scope.description: Optional exact scope filter, e.g. contacts, customer_segments, invoices

write.description: Filter to write tools (true) or read-only tools (false)

name: search_tools

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
